claims.content: The use case starts when a JU ceases reporting a surveillance track (Air, Surface/Maritime, Land/Ground, including ballistic missile tracks) for which it currently has R² and originates a J7.0 Drop Track Report (ACT=0), or when the specified time interval elapses since a remote track's/point's last report and the system has received neither a J7.0 (ACT=0) message nor any further track updates.

The C2 JU terminates and purges surveillance tracks (Air, Surface/Maritime, Land/Ground), including ballistic missile tracks, by transmitting a J7.0 Drop Track Report (ACT=0) or by automatically purging remote tracks after a specified time interval has elapsed since the track's/point's last report.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The C2 JU terminates and purges surveillance tracks (Air, Surface/Maritime, Land/Ground), including ballistic missile tracks, by transmitting a J7.0 Drop Track Report (ACT=0) or by automatically purging remote tracks after a specified time interval has elapsed since the track's/point's last report.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The C2 JU transmits a J7.0 Drop Track Report (ACT=0) for a surveillance track it has been reporting, thereby terminating/purging that track. Automatic timeout purging of a remote track after the specified interval is a supported variant.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The use case begins when a C2 JU decides to terminate a surveillance track it is reporting (initiating the J7.0 ACT=0 drop) or when a remote track's specified time interval since last report has elapsed without a J7.0 (ACT=0) or further updates.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The surveillance track is terminated/purged: either the J7.0 (ACT=0) drop report has been transmitted or the remote track has been automatically purged after the specified interval.
in_scope_actions: Transmitting a J7.0 Drop Track Report (ACT=0) to terminate a track
Automatically purging a remote track after a specified time interval since last report
Terminating/purging the supported surveillance track categories (Air, Surface/Maritime, Land/Ground, ballistic missile)
excluded_adjacent_actions: Using PPLI data from J2 messages to reduce redundancy of surveillance track reporting
Terminating EW product information transmission when no longer valid or time-update requirements are not met
Downstream administrative or reporting processes after track purge
variant_dimensions: Termination mechanism: explicit J7.0 (ACT=0) message vs automatic timeout purge
Track type: ballistic missile tracks vs other remote tracks

claims.content: Exception to the main-flow step where the C2 JU would transmit a J7.0 Drop Track Report (ACT=0): if the C2 JU ceases reporting the track because it has relinquished R² to another JU, the J7.0 (ACT=0) Drop Track Report shall not be transmitted.

Exception to the main-flow expectation that a remote track is terminated by an explicit J7.0 (ACT=0) or continues to receive updates: if the system receives neither a J7.0 (ACT=0) message nor any further updates on the remote track, it may automatically purge the track after a time interval; under this automatic purge condition, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall not be transmitted.
Exception to the main-flow step where an automatic timeout purge would be performed: if the track/point is a DATUM (DRT=4), it shall not be purged automatically.

missing_aspects: Evidence supports the condition and suppression of the message, but does not explicitly define the 'Exit' state or confirm that 'the branch ends'.

Evidence supports the condition for automatic purging and the suppression of the message, but does not explicitly define the 'Exit' state as 'the track is automatically purged without transmitting a J7.0 (ACT=0) message'.
Evidence supports the constraint that DATUMS are not purged, but does not explicitly define the 'Exit' state as 'the automatic purge is not performed for the DATUM'.

claims.content: A J7.0 (ACT=0) Drop Track Report has been transmitted for the track specified in the Reference TN field; the C2 JU has dropped/ceased reporting that track, including a ballistic missile track for which it had reporting responsibility.

Remote tracks/points (DRT=0-3), including ballistic missile tracks, for which no J7.0 (ACT=0) Drop Track Report was received and no further updates occurred have been automatically purged after the specified time interval.
For a remote track/point automatically purged after the specified time interval, the C2 JU has not transmitted a J7.0 (ACT=0) Drop Track Report.
C2 JU

Diverges from Step 2, where the C2 JU would transmit a J7.0 Drop Track Report (ACT=0): instead of transmitting that message, if the track is a remote track/point (DRT=0-3) and the C2 JU receives neither a J7.0 (ACT=0) message nor any further updates, the C2 JU may automatically purge the track/point after the specified time interval has elapsed since its last report; under this automatic purge condition, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall not be transmitted.

Diverges from Step 2 for a remote ballistic missile track: if the C2 JU receives no J7.0 (ACT=0) message and no further updates on the track, the C2 JU automatically purges the track after the specified time interval, and no J7.0 (ACT=0) message is transmitted.
The C2 JU currently has R² (reporting responsibility) for the surveillance track that is to be terminated, including a ballistic missile track for which it is ceasing reporting.

The C2 JU has a remote track/point for which it has received neither a J7.0 (ACT=0) Drop Track Report nor any further track updates since the track's/point's last report, and which is subject to automatic purging after a specified time interval.

The JU terminates and purges a surveillance track via one of two alternative branches: (A) the explicit-drop branch, in which the JU ceases reporting a track for which it currently has R² (Air, Surface/Maritime, Land/Ground, or ballistic missile tracks); or (B) the automatic timeout-purge branch, in which a remote track/point is automatically purged after a specified time interval when no J7.0 (ACT=0) message is received and no further updates occur; no J7.0 (ACT=0) message is transmitted on the purged remote track/point.
The C2 JU transmits a J7.0 Track Management message with the Track Management Action field set to 0 (Drop Track Report), identifying the dropped/ceased track by its Reference TN.
The J7.0 (ACT=0) Drop Track Report indicates that the C2 JU has dropped or ceased reporting the track specified in the Reference TN field.
The transmission of the J7.0 (ACT=0) Drop Track Report indicates the cessation of reporting for the specified track.

If the system/JU does not receive a J7.0 (ACT=0) message and receives no further updates on a remote track, it automatically purges the remote track/point after a specified time interval; in this automatic purge case, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall not be transmitted.

inconsistency_hints: The trigger's explicit-termination clause starts only when a JU ceases reporting a ballistic missile track, while the preconditions and main-flow step 1 cover all surveillance track categories (Air, Surface/Maritime, Land/Ground, and ballistic missile). Explicit termination of a non-ballistic surveillance track therefore has no entry path from the trigger into the main flow.

The trigger includes an automatic-timeout-purge alternative, but the main flow only models the explicit J7.0 (ACT=0) drop path. There are no main-flow steps for automatically purging a remote track/point after the specified interval, so the postconditions for automatic purge (auto-purged tracks and no J7.0 transmitted) are unreachable.

The Main Flow is written as a single ordered sequence that always starts with the explicit J7.0 (ACT=0) drop path (claims 0-3) and only later handles automatic purging in step 5. The Trigger, however, defines the automatic timeout purge as an independent alternative way for the use case to start, not as a follow-on after an explicit drop. As written, a timeout-driven start would still require the explicit drop steps to occur before the auto-purge branch, contradicting the Trigger and the postcondition that no J7.0 (ACT=0) is transmitted in the auto-purge case.
